New Year's Resolutions

  • 〠이하늘 | Hanel Lee
☀︎
2026.05.05

Repeat, repeat, repeat.

Year after year, twelve months and Friday night come every week.

Nothing new, nothing new.

Am I living the same day as yesterday or tomorrow?

Is today already in the past, have now already become old?

How was it yesterday, last week, last month, last year, or even 10 years ago...

Is time linear so that I should run through all my life to visit the past, where I was born?

So I run, run, run

run back to see the faces that I have forgotten, forgotten that I have forgotten

But I only go further

so further away into the future that I start to see the back of my head

the future, there's nothing new

The same old back, only facing forward, that I could never reach

repeating the same old new year's resolutions
